subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw support for callback fields that are siblings of `action.value`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent agent-facing shape affects channel message semantics and compatibility for existing button commands, and related attempts disagree on structured JSON versus command-string append.

options.title: Structured Additive Payload
options.body: Review or replace the linked PR with a JSON text payload for callbacks that include form/input/select fields while leaving simple button commands unchanged.

options.title: Command-Argument Append
options.body: Append selected form and selector values to the existing command-text path, reducing parser churn but losing a richer callback envelope.

options.title: Defer Callback Expansion
options.body: Keep only `action.value` support for now and leave form/select card actions unsupported until a broader Feishu interaction design lands.

recommendation.title: Structured Additive Payload
recommendation.body: Review or replace the linked PR with a JSON text payload for callbacks that include form/input/select fields while leaving simple button commands unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest current ownership signal on Feishu card-action and monitor paths.
